note: Medicine Bow NF campground beside the upper Medicine Bow River in the Snowy Range, in lodgepole and spruce forest with well-separated sites. Reached by Forest Road 100, a slow 20-mile drive from the Snowy Range Highway, or from Elk Mountain on Carbon County Road 101. --Claude
